parameters.jsCode: const parse = (v) => { const s=typeof v==='string'?v:JSON.stringify(v); try{return JSON.parse(s)}catch{return {raw:s}} }; const get = n => parse($(n).first().json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || $(n).first().json); const input=$('Normalize Circular').first().json; const rules=get('Agent 4 - Rule Authoring').rules || []; const allowedFields=['amount','transaction_type','customer_risk','country_code']; const allowedOps=['gt','gte','lt','lte','eq','neq','in']; const allowedActions=['flag','review','hold']; const checked=rules.map(r=>{const d=r.dsl||{};const valid=allowedFields.includes(d.field)&&allowedOps.includes(d.operator)&&allowedActions.includes(d.action)&&Object.keys(d).sort().join(',')==='action,field,operator,value';return {...r,validation:{valid,status:valid?'DRAFT':'REJECTED'}}}); return [{json:{circular_id:input.circular_id,bank_profile:input.bank_profile,applicability:get('Agent 1 - Applicability'),obligations:get('Agent 2 - Obligation Extraction'),policy_mapping:get('Agent 3 - Policy Mapping'),rules:checked,validation:get('Agent 5 - Validation'),impact_analysis:get('Agent 6 - Impact Analysis'),approval_required:true,deployment_status:'WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL',warning:'AI-generated draft. Not legal advice. No live banking changes.'}}];
